description: Read community check-ins and comments for one Open Charge Map station — the real-world reliability signal beyond the operator-reported registry status. Returns user comments and fault reports with ratings, dates, and the outcome the driver recorded ("Charged Successfully", "Failed to Charge (Equipment Not Operational)", …), alongside the station's current registry status and last-verified date, surfacing mismatches like "listed operational, but the last few check-ins report a fault." A busy station's check-ins come back one page at a time: when a page reports truncated, repeat the call with the reported nextOffset to read the next one.

maxresults.description: Maximum comments to return, newest first. Max 100.

offset.description: Comments to skip before the returned page, for reading past a truncated result. Repeat the same call with the nextOffset value the previous one reported. Ordering is newest-first and stable, but a check-in posted between pages shifts what a later offset lands on.

name: openchargemap_get_station_comments

attribution.description: Required CC BY 4.0 attribution to Open Charge Map contributors.

cap.description: The maxresults cap that was applied.

comments.description: The requested page of community comments, newest first — offset/maxresults applied. Empty with totalComments 0 means OCM has no check-ins for this station (absence of reports is not evidence the charger works); empty with a non-zero totalComments means the offset is past the last comment.

checkinStatus.description: The visit outcome the driver recorded (e.g. "Charged Successfully", "Failed to Charge (Equipment Not Operational)"). Carries the result on check-ins that have no comment text. Absent when the visitor recorded no outcome.

checkinStatusId.description: Numeric ID of the check-in outcome, stable across renames of its title.

checkinStatusIsPositive.description: Whether the registry classes this outcome as a good visit. Absent when the outcome carries no verdict either way (e.g. "Did Not Visit Location") or when none was recorded.

dateCreated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp the comment was posted.

rating.description: User rating 1–5. null when not given.

relatedUrl.description: Link the commenter attached. Absent when none was given.

dateLastVerified.description: ISO 8601 date the listing was last verified. null when never verified.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `not_found`: OCM returned an empty result for the given numeric ID (HTTP 200 with []) — no such station. `upstream_unavailable`: OCM returned a non-2xx response or timed out. `auth_failed`: OCM returned HTTP 401 or 403 — the API key is missing or invalid. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

isOperational.description: Whether the registry marks the station operational. Absent when the operational state is unknown. Compare against the comments below — they are the real-world check.

nextOffset.description: The offset to pass on an otherwise identical call to read the next page. Absent on the last page.

notice.description: How to reach the comments this page left out, or why the station has none on record.

registryStatusId.description: Registry status ID — the value the openchargemap_find_stations statustypeid filter takes. Absent when OCM has no status on record.

reliabilityNote.description: A caveat when the registry status, verification age, coordinates, or comments suggest the listing may not reflect reality. Omitted when there is nothing to flag.

stationId.description: OCM station ID the comments belong to.

totalComments.description: Comments this station has on record — the whole set, before offset/maxresults selected the page in comments. reliabilityNote counts its fault ratio over this population, not over the page.

totalCount.description: Comments this station has on record, before the offset/maxresults page was taken — the complete count, not the page size.

truncated.description: True when comments were left out of the returned page.

title: openchargemap-mcp-server: get station comments
